'''James Lafferty''' (Jim Lafferty) finished 4th at the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]. He was a 1998 World Finalist and reached the 1999 main event through the DecipherCon Wild Card (2nd of 160+). He played all three days of 1999 Worlds.

== Tournament results ==

* final twelve, [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]
* 4th, [[1999 Decipher World Championship]] ([[1999 Decipher World Championship James Lafferty DS|ISB Operations]] / [[1999 Decipher World Championship James Lafferty LS|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]])
